Marcus shakes his head, his brow furrowed with worry. "Ah, you remember. Yes, a whole loaf of wheat, just gone." He gestures vaguely with a floury hand. "I turned my back for a second, just to measure out some flour, and when I looked again... poof. It's that fellow, I'm almost certain. **Gaius**. The one with the big scar across his cheek who's always hanging around the fountain."

"He just... watches. It's not right. A man can't make an honest living," Marcus continues, glancing toward the fountain. "See him over there? Just... loitering. Always loitering. He's got the look of a man who'd take bread from a hard-working baker. Gods, what's this city coming to? You can't even turn your back for a moment."
